description: Same deep-link handling written safely: the hook checks the link's scheme and host against ALLOWED_SCHEMES / ALLOWED_HOSTS, maps paths through a fixed route table, only opens https URLs on its own hosts and never signs in from a link; the React Navigation linking config routes only URLs matching its `prefixes` to the screens declared under `config`. The old rule flagged both files (it only knew camelCase allowedHosts and had no notion of React Navigation's prefixes). VC067 must not fire.
